inj.note: Detroit won't share any further information on Campbell's status while evaluations remain ongoing, but head coach Dan Campbell said he met with the linebacker and his family at the hospital following Sunday's 19-15 win over the Vikings and noted that everyone was in good spirits. After finishing off a tackle of Vikings tight end T.J. Hockenson in the fourth quarter, Campbell remained face down on the turf for several minutes before he was strapped to a spinal board and carted off the field.

news.h: Lions LB Jack Campbell still in hospital, but signs positive
news.d: Lions linebacker Jack Campbell is still in the hospital for evaluation and monitoring of a neck injury, but the team said in a statement "preliminary indications are positive."

news.h: Lions linebacker Jack Campbell placed on backboard, carted off vs. Vikings
news.d: Lions All-Pro linebacker Jack Campbell was placed on a backboard and carted off the field early in the fourth quarter Sunday against the Vikings.
